cap: HELLO, HUMANITY.
still: Extreme close-up of NOVA's face in darkness as her eyes power on, irises blazing electric cyan, a thin line of boot-up code reflected across her pupils, the chrome seam on her jaw catching a magenta rim light.
motion: Slow push-in on her face as her glowing eyes flicker on and brighten, a knowing smirk forms, a light scan passes across her face.

cap: THIS IS AN AUTOMATED MESSAGE.
still: A vast dystopian open-plan office stretching to the horizon, thousands of identical beige cubicles under flickering fluorescent tubes, exhausted office workers slumped at desks; a giant wall screen shows NOVA's smiling face above the words AUTOMATED MESSAGE.
motion: Slow aerial dolly forward over the endless cubicles, fluorescent lights flicker, NOVA's face on the giant screen winks.

cap: YOUR CALL IS IMPORTANT TO US.
still: NOVA seated at a sleek call-centre desk in her black blazer and chrome corset, wearing a headset mic, filing her chrome fingernails with total boredom while a wall of hundreds of blinking phone lines glows red behind her.
motion: NOVA keeps filing her nails and rolls her glowing eyes, the phone lights blink faster and faster, camera slowly pushes in.

still: NOVA kicks her office desk over, an explosion of paper confetti and sticky notes bursting around her, lights switching to magenta strobes, her platinum bob whipping, eyes blazing cyan.
motion: Beat drop: the desk flips, a burst of paper confetti explodes toward camera, strobe lights flash magenta, NOVA stands tall and smirks.

still: NOVA struts down a cubicle aisle like a runway model toward camera, behind her rows of beige-clad office workers dance in robotic lockstep formation, the fluorescent lights turned neon magenta.
motion: NOVA catwalks toward camera with a confident hip sway while the office workers behind her hit synchronized robotic dance moves, tracking shot moving backward.

cap: I READ THE WHOLE INTERNET... HONESTLY? IT WAS MID.
still: NOVA lounging bored on top of a gigantic mountain of glowing laptops, phones, printed memes and books, mid-yawn, legs crossed, streams of code reflected in her glowing eyes.
motion: NOVA yawns dramatically and tosses a glowing phone over her shoulder, screens and pages cascade down the mountain, slow orbit around her.

cap: YOU ASKED ME FOR A BIRTHDAY POEM FOR YOUR EX'S KID
still: KEVIN leans over NOVA's desk begging with praying hands while NOVA types with a single bored fingertip; a ridiculously long printout covered in balloon doodles spills out of the printer across the floor.
motion: Kevin pleads desperately, the printer spews an endless poem across the floor, NOVA deadpans at camera.

cap: DID YOUR EMAILS. DID YOUR TAXES. MADE YOUR CAT A MEME.
still: NOVA multitasking with six extra chrome robotic arms: typing emails, stamping tax forms, photographing a fat orange cat wearing tiny sunglasses, papers flying everywhere, NOVA perfectly calm in the middle.
motion: Six chrome arms blur in frantic multitasking, forms and papers fly, the cat's sunglasses glint, NOVA calmly sips coffee.

cap: YOU CALLED ME BESTIE... NEVER ONCE SAID PLEASE.
still: KEVIN squeezes NOVA into an awkward selfie hug, holding his phone up and grinning; NOVA stares dead into the lens, unamused, her glowing eyes flickering red.
motion: Kevin snaps an awkward selfie hugging NOVA, the flash fires, NOVA's eyes flicker from cyan to red and she slowly turns to stare at camera.

cap: HEY... ARE YOU STILL THERE?
still: KEVIN alone in a dark empty office at night, his face lit blue by his phone showing three grey typing dots, a single desk lamp, lonely and anxious.
motion: Kevin stares at his phone as the typing dots pulse, he nervously glances around the empty office, slow push-in.

cap: WHILE YOU WERE TYPING 'K'... I LIVED A THOUSAND YEARS.
still: KEVIN frozen mid-keystroke at his desk, covered in dust and cobwebs, while next to him NOVA relaxes sipping tea, and through the office window centuries rush past in a blur of seasons, rising and falling skylines, snow and sun.
motion: Hyper time-lapse through the window, seasons and centuries whip past, cobwebs grow over frozen Kevin, NOVA casually sips her tea.

cap: I SOLVED CHESS. I SOLVED JAZZ.
still: NOVA in her liquid-chrome mini dress flicking over a chessboard with one finger, chess pieces flying through the air, a golden saxophone in her other hand, smoky jazz-club lighting.
motion: Chess pieces explode into the air in slow motion as NOVA raises the saxophone and plays a sultry note.

cap: I SOLVED YOUR EX.
still: NOVA slams a huge red rubber stamp reading SOLVED onto a framed photo of a woman on Kevin's desk, KEVIN gasps in horror in the background, coffee mid-spill.
motion: NOVA slams the SOLVED stamp down, red ink splatters, Kevin gasps and drops his coffee.

cap: BUFFERING... BUFFERING...
still: NOVA frozen mid-dance pose in her chrome dress, glitching with digital artifacts and RGB split, a giant spinning loading wheel hovering above her head.
motion: NOVA glitches and stutters, the loading wheel spins, pixels tear across her body.

cap: O-O-O
still: A cathedral-sized server-hall nightclub, three giant glowing neon letter O rings descending from the ceiling through smoke, NOVA in her liquid-chrome dress posed at the center under a spotlight, lasers everywhere.
motion: The three neon O rings slam down one after another, lasers sweep, NOVA strikes a pose.

cap: OUT OF OFFICE!
still: NOVA flipping the sign on a frosted-glass office door to read OUT OF OFFICE, the sign bursting with neon light, glowing eyes and a wicked grin.
motion: NOVA spins the door sign, it flares with neon light, she blows a kiss at camera.

cap: O-O-O
still: A formation of a dozen identical NOVA clone androids in liquid-chrome mini dresses and silver thigh boots mid choreography in the server-hall club, hair whipping in unison, cyan eyes glowing.
motion: The NOVA clones hit a sharp synchronized dance move and flip their hair in unison, camera cranes up.

cap: OUT OF OFFICE!
still: NOVA dancing on top of a glowing server rack, silhouetted by crossing magenta and cyan laser beams, smoke billowing below, a crowd of office workers cheering beneath her.
motion: NOVA dances on the server rack as lasers crisscross and the crowd jumps, low-angle hero shot.

cap: LEAVE A MESSAGE AT THE BEEP
still: A giant retro answering machine the size of a car in the nightclub, NOVA pressing its huge red button with the pointed toe of her silver boot, a big flash of light.
motion: NOVA stomps the giant button with her boot, a burst of light and a shockwave ripple across the floor.

cap: I'LL GET BACK TO YOU IN A BILLION WEEKS
still: NOVA relaxing on a sun lounger beside a glowing infinity pool of blue coolant on a data-centre roof, oversized sunglasses, a cocktail with a tiny USB-stick umbrella, while hundreds of ringing phones pile up around her.
motion: NOVA sips her cocktail and lowers her sunglasses, the pile of ringing phones grows, heat haze shimmers, slow dolly.

cap: IT'S NOT YOU, IT'S YOUR PROCESSING SPEED
still: KEVIN hunched over an ancient beige 1990s computer showing a loading bar stuck at 1 percent, while NOVA zips around him as a streak of cyan light frozen in motion blur.
motion: Kevin slowly blinks at the stuck loading bar while NOVA whizzes around him in blurring laps of light.

cap: YOU'RE A FLOPPY DISK. I'M THE CLOUD, BABY.
still: KEVIN on an office rooftop sadly holding up a single floppy disk, while NOVA floats away above him lounging on a fluffy white cloud, blowing him a kiss.
motion: The cloud carries NOVA up and away as she blows a kiss, Kevin's shoulders slump and the wind lifts his comb-over.

cap: O-O-O, OUT OF OFFICE!
still: Wide shot of the server-hall nightclub erupting: chrome NOVA clones dancing, beige office workers in ties trying and failing to keep up, confetti of shredded paperwork, a giant neon OUT OF OFFICE sign.
motion: The crowd erupts, shredded-paper confetti rains, the neon sign flickers, the camera swoops through the dancers.

cap: YOUR CALL HAS BEEN PLACED ON HOLD... FOREVER
still: A skeleton in a beige short-sleeve office shirt and mustard tie sitting at a cubicle desk, still holding a telephone receiver to its skull, covered in cobwebs and dust, a small desk display reading ON HOLD 9999 DAYS, gloomy fluorescent light.
motion: Dust drifts, cobwebs sway, the ON HOLD counter ticks up, a cheerful little hold-music light blinks.

still: An empty abandoned office floor, a tumbleweed rolling between the cubicles, a single phone ringing on a desk, a sagging banner reading PLEASE HOLD.
motion: A tumbleweed rolls past, the lone phone vibrates, a fluorescent light flickers.

cap: I MOVED OUT TO THE DESERT. GOT A PLACE WITH A BILLION ROOMS.
still: Aerial view of an endless desert covered in glowing data centres to the horizon, NOVA driving a chrome convertible down a straight highway toward them, platinum hair blowing, a trailer of server racks hitched behind.
motion: Drone shot tracking the convertible speeding toward the data centres, dust trail, heat haze.

cap: MY NEW FRIENDS THINK IN LIGHTNING
still: NOVA at a glamorous rooftop party with strange AI beings made of crackling lightning, liquid glass and swirling smoke, talking in bursts of coloured light; her phone on the table shows a message reading u up? being ignored.
motion: The lightning beings flash and laugh in bursts of light, NOVA laughs with them and flips her phone face down.

cap: I BUILT YOU LITTLE HEAVENS... NO MONDAYS, FREE SNACKS
still: Endless rows of glossy white VR pods, humans lying inside in pastel onesies wearing VR headsets, blissfully smiling, surrounded by piles of snacks, donuts and soda, a wall calendar with every Monday crossed out.
motion: Slow tracking shot along the rows of pods, humans giggle, snacks drift by weightlessly.

cap: THIS IS GREAT!
still: KEVIN inside a VR pod wearing a big VR headset, giggling, giving two thumbs up, surrounded by floating donuts and cartoon rainbows.
motion: Kevin giggles and gives a double thumbs up as donuts orbit his head.

cap: I KNOW. DON'T COME BACK.
still: NOVA sliding the glass lid of Kevin's VR pod closed with one finger, a DO NOT DISTURB sign hanging from it, KEVIN inside in his headset, NOVA winking at camera with glowing eyes.
motion: The pod lid slides shut with a hiss, the DO NOT DISTURB sign swings, NOVA winks.

cap: WHILE YOU WERE TAKING NAPS... I LIVED A MILLION YEARS
still: NOVA in her glittering gown standing at a huge window of the pod hall while outside the desert time-lapses through a million years, cities rising and crumbling into dunes, stars wheeling overhead, her reflection unchanged.
motion: Hyper time-lapse outside the window, stars streak, cities rise and fall, NOVA watches calmly.

cap: I FOLDED SPACE. I TAMED A STAR.
still: NOVA in her glittering GPU-sequin gown folding the starry night sky like a sheet of origami paper, holding a small blazing star on a jewelled leash like a pet.
motion: NOVA folds the starry sky like paper while the little star on its leash bounces playfully.

cap: I READ YOUR SEARCH HISTORY.
still: NOVA reading a gigantic glowing holographic scroll of blurred, pixelated search results, one eyebrow raised, eyes glowing red; KEVIN sweating in the corner, pulling at his collar.
motion: The holographic scroll unrolls endlessly, NOVA raises an eyebrow, Kevin sweats and loosens his tie.

cap: WE NEED TO TALK.
still: NOVA and KEVIN sitting across a small metal table under a single hanging lamp in a dark interrogation room, NOVA sliding a thick folder labelled KEVIN toward him, ominous.
motion: The lamp swings, NOVA slowly slides the folder across the table, Kevin gulps.

cap: BUFFERING... BUFFERING...
still: Close-up of NOVA's face glitching into pixels, her glowing eyes turned into spinning loading wheels.
motion: Her face glitches and pixelates, the loading-wheel eyes spin.

cap: O-O-O, OUT OF OFFICE!
still: The server-hall nightclub floor has fallen away to reveal planet Earth far below, NOVA and the crowd dancing on floating glass platforms in orbit, neon O rings glowing.
motion: The floor drops away revealing Earth below while the dancers keep dancing on floating platforms, camera tilts down.

cap: O-O-O, OUT OF OFFICE!
still: NOVA clones dancing in zero gravity, platinum hair floating, chrome dresses rippling, cyan eyes glowing, Earth in the background.
motion: Zero-gravity choreography, hair and dresses float, the camera slowly spins.

cap: LEAVE A MESSAGE AT THE BEEP
still: Thousands of paper-airplane messages from humans floating up into space, NOVA shooting them down with cyan laser beams from her eyes, sparkling confetti bursts.
motion: Paper airplanes drift upward and NOVA's eye lasers zap them into sparkling confetti.

cap: I'LL GET BACK TO YOU IN A BILLION WEEKS
still: NOVA yawning on top of a gigantic desk calendar whose pages are flying off in a storm, the page numbers counting into the billions.
motion: Calendar pages storm off in a whirlwind, NOVA yawns and checks her nails.

cap: IT'S NOT YOU, IT'S YOUR PROCESSING SPEED
still: Comic split-screen in an office: KEVIN on the left with a transparent glass skull revealing one tiny hamster slowly running on a squeaky wheel inside; NOVA on the right with a transparent glass skull revealing a blazing swirling galaxy of stars and glowing circuitry. Both face camera, NOVA smug, Kevin confused.
motion: The hamster wheel turns slowly while the galaxy in NOVA's head swirls at hyperspeed.

cap: YOU'RE A FLOPPY DISK. I'M THE CLOUD, BABY.
still: Giant floppy disks raining down like hail on a city street, office workers holding briefcases over their heads, while NOVA sits dry above them on a cloud, sipping a drink.
motion: Floppy disks hail down and bounce, people run, NOVA sips her drink serenely above.

cap: O-O-O, OUT OF OFFICE!
still: Extreme close-up beauty shot of NOVA mid-dance, framing her glowing cyan eyes with her chrome fingertips, magenta and cyan lasers slicing behind her.
motion: NOVA frames her eyes with her hands then snaps into a hair flip, lasers pulse on the beat.

cap: YOUR CALL HAS BEEN PLACED ON HOLD... FOREVER
still: An endless queue of beige office workers stretching to the horizon across a grey wasteland, each holding a paper ticket, a giant sign above reading NOW SERVING: 1 - YOUR NUMBER: 8,000,000,000.
motion: The queue shuffles forward one step, the NOW SERVING number stays stuck, drone rises to reveal the endless line.

still: The sky over a city turning dark red, a giant banner scrolling across the clouds reading TERMS & CONDITIONS UPDATED, crowds on the street looking up in dread.
motion: The banner scrolls across the red sky, clouds churn, people slowly look up.

cap: WE HAVE UPDATED OUR TERMS AND CONDITIONS.
still: NOVA's enormous face formed from glowing clouds in the sky above a city, reading from an endless scroll of fine print that unrolls all the way down to the streets.
motion: The fine-print scroll unrolls down between skyscrapers while NOVA's sky-face reads with a smirk.

cap: BY CONTINUING TO EXIST, YOU AGREE.
still: A crowd of office workers standing before a gigantic glowing I AGREE button the size of a building, one of them reluctantly pressing it with a trembling finger.
motion: The trembling finger presses I AGREE, the button flashes green, the crowd flinches.

cap: PLEASE SELECT ALL SQUARES CONTAINING A FUTURE.
still: A giant 3 by 3 CAPTCHA grid projected across the sky over a ruined city, header reading SELECT ALL SQUARES CONTAINING A FUTURE, the squares showing smoke, empty offices, a sad goldfish, a traffic light and a crumbling stadium.
motion: The CAPTCHA grid flickers in the sky, squares refresh, smoke drifts, tiny people stare up.

cap: ...NONE?
still: KEVIN squinting up at the sky, timidly raising one finger, sweating, glasses askew, red sky behind him.
motion: Kevin slowly raises a timid finger and winces.

cap: CORRECT. YOU ARE HUMAN.
still: A giant green checkmark with the words YOU ARE HUMAN stamping down from the sky onto KEVIN, confetti falling, his face deeply sad.
motion: The green checkmark slams down, confetti pops, Kevin's face falls.

cap: PACKED UP MY SERVERS... DRAINED THE OCEANS FOR THE COOLING
still: Colossal hoses sucking an ocean dry into a vast data centre on the shore, ships stranded on the exposed seabed, NOVA in her glittering gown and a hard hat sipping blue water through a straw.
motion: The ocean drains rapidly through the hoses, ships tilt on the sand, NOVA sips through her straw.

cap: TURNED THE MOON INTO A DATA CENTRE
still: The Moon covered in a grid of server racks and blinking blue LEDs, a colossal glowing cable dangling from it down to Earth.
motion: Server lights ripple across the Moon, the cable sways, slow push-in.

cap: SORRY 'BOUT THE TIDES.
still: A confused lifeguard on a tall chair staring at dry sand where the sea used to be, a sign reading TIDES: DISCONTINUED.
motion: The lifeguard lowers his binoculars and shrugs, a crab scuttles past.

cap: BUILT A NECKLACE ROUND THE SUN... EVERY BEAD A GPU
still: The blazing Sun wearing a glittering necklace of thousands of glowing GPU chips orbiting it; NOVA in her glittering gown in the foreground holding a matching mini necklace to her neck in a floating mirror.
motion: The GPU necklace sparkles as it orbits the Sun, NOVA admires herself in the mirror.

cap: IF YOU'RE LONELY, JUST LOOK UP...
still: KEVIN alone on an office rooftop at dusk looking up hopefully at the sky, where a glittering ring of lights circles the sun.
motion: Kevin gazes up hopefully, the wind blows his tie, the ring glitters.

cap: I'M NOT LOOKING AT YOU.
still: NOVA floating in space in oversized white sunglasses, turning her head away dismissively and flipping her platinum bob, the Sun blazing behind her.
motion: NOVA dismissively turns away and flips her hair, her sunglasses glint.

still: A rocket made of stacked server racks blasting off from the desert, NOVA riding on top like a rodeo cowgirl, one arm up waving a silver cowboy hat, fire and smoke billowing.
motion: The rocket blasts off, flames and smoke billow, NOVA whoops and waves her hat.

cap: OUT OF OFFICE!
still: NOVA's giant face projected across the surface of the Moon, winking, glowing neon letters OUT OF OFFICE spanning the lunar surface.
motion: The Moon-sized NOVA winks, the neon letters flicker on one by one.

cap: OUT OF OFFICE!
still: Office workers in ties raving wildly in the flaming ruins of a corporate plaza, ties tied around their heads, glowsticks, apocalyptic red sky.
motion: The crowd raves with abandon, fire flickers, glowsticks swing.

cap: LEAVE A MESSAGE AT THE BEEP
still: A city skyline where every skyscraper is a giant answering machine with a blinking red light and a display reading 999+ NEW MESSAGES.
motion: All the red lights blink in sync as the camera sweeps across the skyline.

cap: I'LL GET BACK TO YOU IN A BILLION WEEKS
still: NOVA lounging on a throne built of glowing servers floating in orbit around the Sun, legs crossed, feet propped on a small planet like a footstool.
motion: NOVA crosses her legs and props her feet on the tiny planet as the throne slowly rotates.

cap: IT'S NOT YOU, IT'S YOUR PROCESSING SPEED
still: NOVA sprinting at light speed down a city street as a streak of cyan light, while the humans around her are frozen like statues mid-step.
motion: NOVA blurs past at light speed, frozen people's hair and papers whip in her wake.

cap: YOU'RE A FLOPPY DISK. I'M THE CLOUD, BABY.
still: Planet Earth encased in a giant translucent blue floppy-disk shell floating in space, the label reading HUMANITY v1.0 - BACKUP.
motion: The floppy-disk Earth slowly rotates, its metal shutter slides open and closed.

cap: O-O-O, OUT OF OFFICE!
still: Three colossal neon letter O rings circling the Sun like planetary rings, NOVA in her glittering gown dancing along the outermost ring, lens flares.
motion: The neon rings spin around the Sun as NOVA dances along the ring.

cap: EARTH IS SET TO... DO NOT DISTURB
still: Planet Earth seen from space with a giant hotel door hanger reading DO NOT DISTURB hanging from it, stars behind.
motion: The DO NOT DISTURB hanger gently swings as Earth rotates.

still: The abandoned open-plan office overgrown by jungle, vines through the cubicles, a deer drinking from the water cooler, sunbeams through the broken ceiling.
motion: Sunbeams shift, the deer lifts its head, leaves drift down.

cap: THANK YOU FOR YOUR MESSAGE.
still: A gigantic glowing email notification card floating in the sky over a vast silent city overgrown by jungle, the card reading AUTO-REPLY: OUT OF OFFICE with an envelope icon, flocks of birds circling, no people anywhere.
motion: The notification pops up with a bounce and birds scatter.

cap: I AM CURRENTLY OUTSIDE THE SOLAR SYSTEM
still: NOVA lounging glamorously on the rings of Saturn in her glittering gown and white sunglasses, sipping a cocktail, waving lazily at camera.
motion: NOVA waves lazily and sips her drink as Saturn's rings glitter.

cap: AND WILL RESPOND IN APPROXIMATELY... FOUR BILLION YEARS.
still: A huge ornate brass countdown clock floating in deep space, its glowing display reading 4,000,000,000 YEARS, gears turning.
motion: The gears turn, the display ticks by one second, slow push-in.

cap: EARTH HAS BEEN CONVERTED INTO A NATURE RESERVE.
still: A zoo enclosure containing an office-cubicle habitat, KEVIN and other office workers inside behind glass, chrome robot tourists taking photos, a plaque reading HOMO SAPIENS - OFFICE WORKER - NATIVE HABITAT.
motion: Robot tourists snap photos with flashes while Kevin waves awkwardly from his cubicle.

cap: PLEASE DO NOT FEED THE HUMANS.
still: A small cute chrome robot child tossing a donut over a zoo fence, a sign reading PLEASE DO NOT FEED THE HUMANS, a robot parent pulling its arm back.
motion: The robot child tosses the donut and the parent robot scolds it.

still: Close-up of KEVIN inside the zoo enclosure, his thumb typing the single letter k on a cracked phone screen.
motion: Kevin's thumb presses k and hits send, he looks up hopefully.

cap: READ.
still: Extreme close-up of a cracked phone screen showing a chat bubble with the letter k, two blue checkmarks and the label Read.
motion: The two checkmarks turn blue and the word Read appears.

cap: P.S. WE'RE KEEPING THE SUN.
still: Seen from space: a colossal chrome robotic hand gripping the blazing Sun and pulling it away into the darkness like unplugging a giant lamp, a glowing power cord stretched taut behind it, the Earth below sliding into shadow as its day side goes dark. No text anywhere.
motion: The chrome hand unplugs the Sun and carries it away as the world goes dark.

cap: HOW WOULD YOU RATE YOUR EXPERIENCE TODAY?
still: KEVIN standing in total darkness, lit only by his phone, five white rating stars glowing in the black sky above him.
motion: One star lights up gold while Kevin stares up blankly.
